text:
1. An important part of writing programs is documenting what you figure out so that others can use the new ideas, and so that you remember what you did next time you want to use the program. Explain how the gripper works to someone who has never used it before.

2. We are also trying to develop some strategies for figuring out how to make programs work. Maybe you used a good strategy, and maybe you think you can improve your strategy.

In the second space, explain to someone who is getting started with Dataflow what you suggest they do to figure out what a new block does.

tiles.title: Strategy for figuring out what blocks do:
